source: Roark's Formulas, Table 8.1 case 1a (cantilever, end load), with shear
request:
Plan: 200 mm mild steel bar (steel_s235), 10 wide x 20 tall, clamped at the wall end (xmin). The 50 kg hanging mass is a weight of 50 x 9.81 = 490.5 N acting straight down (-Z) on the free end. Checked against the cantilever formula.


source: custom shape: a valid printable solid; fit judged by eye
request:
Plan: PETG clip, FDM. Defaults I chose: body 30 x 16 x 11 mm with three 6.4 mm cable channels (6 mm cable + 0.4 clearance) along Y at 9 mm pitch, each with a 5 mm snap-in slot opening downward; a 16 x 4 mm mounting tab at one end with a 4.5 mm M4 clearance hole. The top face (z = 11) goes against the desk underside; the screw is driven from below through the tab.
```python
from build123d import *
from engagent.cad import params, save
P = params(cable=6.4, pitch=9.0, body_h=11.0, depth=16.0, slot=5.0, tab_t=4.0, tab_l=16.0, hole=4.5)
n = 3
body_l = P.pitch * n + 3.0
body = Box(body_l, P.depth, P.body_h, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
tab = Pos(body_l, 0, P.body_h - P.tab_t) * Box(P.tab_l, P.depth, P.tab_t, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part = body + tab
zc = 5.0
for i in range(n):
    x = 1.5 + P.pitch * (i + 0.5)
    part -= Pos(x, P.depth / 2, zc) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(P.cable / 2, P.depth * 2)
    part -= Pos(x, P.depth / 2, zc / 2 - 1) * Box(P.slot, P.depth * 2, zc + 2)
part -= Pos(body_l + P.tab_l / 2, P.depth / 2, P.body_h - P.tab_t / 2) * Cylinder(P.hole / 2, P.tab_t * 3)
save(part)
```
```bash
ea make geometry.py --print petg --name "cable clip"
```

source: Lame thick-walled cylinder, open ends (axial stress 0): von Mises at the bore
request:
Plan: steel tube OD 100, bore 60 (radius 30), 200 long, axis along Z. Open ends, so the pressure acts on the bore only (no end-cap force). I model a quarter: the tube intersected with the +X/+Y quadrant, symmetry planes slid (xmin in X, ymin in Y), one end slid axially (zmin in Z) so the tube is free to grow. 100 MPa on the bore surface. Checked against the thick-wall (Lame) solution for the bore stress.
```python
from build123d import *
from engagent.cad import params, save
P = params(od=100.0, bore=60.0, length=200.0)
tube = Cylinder(P.od / 2, P.length, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
tube -= Cylinder(P.bore / 2, P.length * 3)
quarter = Box(P.od / 2 + 1, P.od / 2 + 1, P.length, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part = tube & quarter
save(part)
```
```bash
ea make geometry.py --name "thick tube quarter"
ea analyze last -m steel_generic --slide xmin x --slide ymin y --slide zmin z --pressure cyl:30 100 --check "pressure.thick_cylinder p=100 ri=30 ro=50 -> stress@max_von_mises"
```

Plan: PETG comb, FDM. Plate 60 x 20 x 5 mm, five 4 mm slots cut 12 mm deep into the long edge at y = 20, evenly spaced along X (equal gaps between slots and at both ends), leaving an 8 mm solid spine. Default PETG.
```python
from build123d import *
from engagent.cad import params, save
P = params(length=60.0, width=20.0, thickness=5.0, slot=4.0, depth=12.0)
n = 5
part = Box(P.length, P.width, P.thickness, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
gap = (P.length - n * P.slot) / (n + 1)
for i in range(n):
    x = gap * (i + 1) + P.slot * i + P.slot / 2
    part -= Pos(x, P.width - P.depth / 2 + 1, P.thickness / 2) * Box(P.slot, P.depth + 2, P.thickness * 3)
save(part)
```
```bash
ea make geometry.py --print petg --name "cable comb"
```

source: dimensions as asked; D-shaft 6 mm with 4.5 mm flat
request:
Plan: PETG knob, FDM. Defaults I chose: 30 mm diameter x 15 mm tall cylinder with a 1.5 mm fillet on the top edge, and a blind D-hole 9 mm deep from the bottom (z = 0): 6 mm circle with the flat 4.5 mm from the opposite side. The hole is drawn at nominal size, so expect to ream or adjust slightly after printing for a snug fit.
```python
from build123d import *
from engagent.cad import params, save
P = params(diameter=30.0, height=15.0, shaft=6.0, flat=4.5, depth=9.0, fillet_r=1.5)
c = P.diameter / 2
part = Pos(c, c, 0) * Cylinder(c, P.height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part = fillet(part.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1], P.fillet_r)
r = P.shaft / 2
flat_x = c - r + P.flat
d_hole = Pos(c, c, P.depth / 2 - 1) * Cylinder(r, P.depth + 2)
d_hole = d_hole & (Pos(flat_x - 5, c, P.depth / 2) * Box(10, 10, P.depth * 3))
part -= d_hole
save(part)
```
```bash
ea make geometry.py --print petg --name "D-shaft knob"
```
